edits.value_json: Ada swung open the garden gate and called a welcome into the dark. She wanted a grand parade of shadows, while Bo prepared a moonflower welcome for their shy visitor. Somewhere in the garden, Pip waited for an invitation gentle enough to follow.

{"text":"When Ada learned Pip was hiding under the leaves, her sweeping arms drooped. Then she smiled. \"A grand show can whisper.\" She changed it into a still paper-moon tableau, with one tiny space for a moth.","when":[{"key":"ada.plan","op":"eq","value":"tableau","at":"after"},{"key":"ada.knows.pip.location","op":"eq","value":"leaves","at":"before"}]}

{"text":"Pip slipped behind the gate, startled by the bright dancing shapes. Still, the quiet gate opening remained moonlit, and one feeler peeked around the edge. The welcome was unfinished, but not gone. The garden stayed hushed, while a tiny wingbeat stirred the darkness like a question waiting for tomorrow.","when":[{"key":"pip.location","op":"eq","value":"gate","at":"after"},{"key":"pip.content","op":"eq","value":"startled","at":"after"},{"key":"ada.performed.mode","op":"eq","value":"shadows","at":"after"}]}
